title: The 4 Best Humidifiers Under $100
metaDescription: Our 4 picks for humidifiers under $100, with key specs, strengths and limitations for each, based on manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports.
lede: We looked at humidifiers under $100 using manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports. Each pick lists what it does well and where it falls short, so you can match it to how you'll use it.

products.name: LEVOIT Classic 300S Smart Humidifier
products.blurb: Key specs: 6L tank, up to 60 hours runtime, Auto Mode humidity sensor, App and voice assistant control.
strengths: Auto Mode is the single biggest functional upgrade at this price tier
750 sq ft rating and 60-hour tank suit a large bedroom or open living space
App control lets you check and adjust humidity remotely
limitations: 6L tank is heavy to carry once full
Requires weekly descaling with hard tap water

products.name: Honeywell HCM350B Germ Free Cool Mist Humidifier
products.blurb: Key specs: 1.1-gallon wicking filter tank, Self-regulating output, Dishwasher-safe parts.
strengths: Self-limiting wicking filter design reduces over-humidification risk automatically
No mineral dust output, an advantage over filterless ultrasonic units
Dishwasher-safe tank and base simplify weekly cleaning
limitations: No app or smart humidity tracking
1.1-gallon tank needs more frequent refills than the Levoit's 6L

products.name: Vicks Warm Mist Humidifier V745A
products.blurb: Key specs: 1-gallon filter-free tank, Up to 24 hours runtime, VapoPad and VapoSteam compatible.
strengths: Typically the cheapest unit in this price tier, leaving room in the budget
Filter-free design skips a recurring cost entirely
VapoSteam compatibility adds genuine cold and flu season value
limitations: No smart features, dial control only
Higher electricity draw than ultrasonic cool mist units
Warm mist reservoir is a burn hazard around small children

products.name: LEVOIT 2.5L Top-Fill Cool Mist Humidifier
strengths: Top-fill is easy to refill and clean
Quiet for bedrooms (about 25 dB, LEVOIT spec)
limitations: 2.5 L tank suits small to medium rooms
Can leave white dust with hard water

howWeChose: Picks are based on manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports. We don't claim our own testing.
We do not list prices or star ratings because they change. Check Amazon for current details.
